decisions.reason: Changing badge names and icons does not alter the Small Block prize amounts, eligibility, activation, or recurrence.
The badge catalog decision does not change random winner selection, eligible populations, or ticket-based probability weighting.
A First Referral badge does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset behavior.
A First Referral badge does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset behavior.
Replacing the First Mint badge does not change primary-mint revenue allocation.
The First Referral badge records an achievement but does not change the referral commission amount or automatic payout mode.
The badge catalog change does not alter ticket allocation when no referral code is used.
The requirement that permanent badges remain visible in metadata is unchanged; the identities and icons of those badges are owned by the badge-catalog Requirement.
Badge naming and icon choices do not alter Base network deployment behavior.
The badge catalog change does not alter the Big Block prize count, amount, or draw trigger.
Badge design has no effect on the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
Badge naming and icon choices do not change secondary-sale royalty enforcement or use of royalty proceeds.
